name: automotive-marketplace
description: Multi-seller used car marketplace: dealers and private sellers list cars, buyers search, save and message, moderators keep it clean. Installs as a phone app (PWA).

scripts.dev: npm run dev -w server & npm run dev -w web
scripts.build: npm run build -w web && npm run build -w server
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w web
scripts.test: vitest run --root shared && npm test -w server && npm test -w web
